claude_proposed_widenings.name: Effect.half_damage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Circle of Death (and all save-for-half-damage spells) deal exactly half the fail damage on a successful save. The current Effect type has no variant to express this derived relationship. The success branch must be encoded as an independent DiceAmount (4d8 + 1d8/slot), which is numerically correct but loses the invariant that success = fail / 2. A half_damage variant on Effect (or a halfDamageOnSuccess boolean on save_gate) would capture this without duplicating the scaling chain.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: taking 8d8 Necrotic damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one
